arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Chronicles
arcs.summary: Day 3: Seven accessorised duck incidents confirmed across three counties. In every case, the dressed duck faces a specific direction — northeast, east-southeast, or toward a notable but unspecified landmark. The WJES has produced a map; the lines do not quite converge. The wool was identified as 'handspun, cheerful intent.' The hat stitching as 'confident, someone who has made hats before.' The Bandit's purpose remains unclear. Day 4 should advance the cartographic mystery — perhaps the lines do converge after all if the map is oriented differently, or a new duck appears on the Jeep with a different accessory pointing in the missing direction, or a partial witness sighting surfaces.
